title: BCGOS Onboarding Depth
description: Captured choice between the short (~2 min) and complete (~10 min) onboarding flows. Downstream advisory behavior (CLAUDE.md 3-option axis) is depth-aware and reads this file.

depth.description: short = essentials only (name, role, style). complete = adds current project, BCG context, OS evolution intent.

captured_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the choice.
